name: Technological University Dublin
summary: Dublin's technological university: about 100 honours degrees through CAO, from Architecture and Engineering to Culinary Arts, Music and Drama.

ib.text: Six subjects with Maths and English (or Irish); no third language. Some ask more: Engineering (General Entry) HL Maths 5; Mathematics and Statistics Maths SL 6 or HL 4; Law and Journalism HL English 5.

programmes.name: Architecture
programmes.about: Studio-based design projects for buildings in urban and rural settings, alongside the history and theory of architecture, environment, construction, digital communication and law. Two years of postgraduate experience lead to the RIAI professional exam.
programmes.ib: HL 5 in two subjects, with Maths and English at SL 4 (HL 3). A portfolio and an interview are required.
programmes.selectionNote: Submit 10 to 20 pieces of work; it is assessed in a 20-minute interview in May about your motivation for architecture.
programmes.tuitionEuEea: €3,000 a year, as TU Dublin lists it

flagshipSource.title: TU Dublin Architecture: a five-year BArch recognised internationally, with a route to RIAI membership

programmes.name: Drama (Performance)
programmes.about: Acting technique, voice and language in performance including Shakespeare, physical skills through movement, singing, dance and combat, and drama facilitation, taught at TU Dublin Conservatory. A small intake of 20.
programmes.ib: English at SL 6 or HL 4, with HL 5 in two subjects. Irish is no longer asked for. Every applicant auditions.
programmes.selectionNote: A three-hour audition: group workshop, a memorised 2 to 3 minute monologue, movement and a Q&A. A self-tape is possible if you cannot attend.
programmes.tuitionEuEea: €3,000 a year, as TU Dublin lists it

flagshipSource.title: TU Dublin Drama (Performance): taught by the Conservatory, which has over 25 years' experience in drama training

faculties.name: Faculty of Arts and Humanities
faculties.line: Creative courses select by audition or portfolio; Drama (Performance) asks English SL 6 or HL 4, and Irish is dropped from 2027.

faculties.name: Faculty of Business
faculties.line: Business degrees run across several campuses, each listing its own Maths and English grades on its course page.

faculties.name: Faculty of Computing, Digital and Data
faculties.line: Computing, AI, cyber security, data and maths degrees at levels 6 to 8; Mathematics and Statistics asks Maths SL 6 or HL 4.

faculties.name: Faculty of Engineering and Built Environment
faculties.line: Engineering (General Entry) needs HL Maths 5 or a pass in TU Dublin's Maths Competency Test; Architecture needs a portfolio and interview.

faculties.name: Faculty of Sciences and Health
faculties.line: 31 science and health courses across levels 6 to 8 and several campuses; each course page names its own science grade.

notes: Architecture (TU832) selects with a portfolio and an interview, several art and design courses ask for a portfolio, and Music and Drama audition.
From 2027 Drama (Performance) TU962 no longer requires Irish; it asks O2/H6 in English instead, which is IB SL 6 or HL 4.
